# Domain Intelligence API

> Domain overviews for security and sales: registration, infrastructure, and risk signals.

Part of the **DataLeads** API suite (Security category). Requests render in a real browser with anti-bot handling and protected-page support built in - no proxies to manage, no infrastructure to run.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/domain/overview` | V1 Domain Overview |

## Quick start

```bash
curl -X POST https://data.dataleads.pro/v1/domain/overview \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY", "domain": "github.com"}'
```

Replace `YOUR_CLIENT_KEY` with your key. Get one at [https://data.dataleads.pro](https://data.dataleads.pro) - free tier included.

## MCP server

- **Remote (Streamable HTTP):** `https://data.dataleads.pro/mcp/domain-intelligence`
- **Stdio (Docker):** `docker run -e DATALEADS_API_KEY=yourkey ghcr.io/dataleads/domain-intelligence-mcp:latest`
